authority_rule: A retained contribution is not the champion. It may be integrated into a later challenger, which must independently pass the champion promotion gate before the champion registry changes.

contributions.finding: Three-bar causal temporal context improves transition recognition and reduces false transitions, but slightly degrades point-state accuracy when used as the full primary classifier.
contributions.integration_note: Not selected by v10, but retained as an alternate short temporal signal for future research if a new protocol has a specific reason to revisit it.

contributions.finding: Six-bar causal temporal context carries strong transition information but is too dominant when used as a standalone primary classifier. A small blend into v5 preserves point-state floors while improving transition behavior.

A 30% six-bar temporal auxiliary log-probability blend into the v5 primary head preserves the champion point-state floor and improves transition F1 and false-transition control. This validates the contribution-extraction research loop.

Three different post-classification transition mechanisms failed to beat v5: manual typed confirmation, Markov persistence filtering, and learned switch gating. Do not continue stacking postprocessors on the same state classifier without new evidence.
